| Ancient Lineage | `racenomi:ancient_lineage` | The Lineage Factor of an ancient giant gives the bearer the first conquerors' blood, horns and skin: they are tough and blows do not push them back. A trait grafted over the race. Up to 3 traits are stable; each one more takes 10% of max health and 15% of every trait's numbers. |
| Birkan Lineage | `racenomi:birkan_lineage` | The Lineage Factor of a Birkan makes the bearer hit a bit harder and take blows better, with a Birkan's wings.
